title.narrative: Punjab Irrigated Agriculture Investment Program Tranche 3

description.narrative:
Pakpattan Canal and Suleimanki Barrage Improvement Project (PCSBIP) is located in Punjab Province of Pakistan. Improvement of Suleimanki Barrage will ensure reliable water supply to 1.01 million ha through its three canals including Pakpattan, Fordwah and Eastern canals and will benefit more than 360,000 farming families. Pakpattan canal alone provides irrigation to 500,000 ha. Rehabilitation and upgrading of only Pakpattan canal along with Suleimanki Barrage is included under the project. Rehabilitation of the other two canals is not needed immediately.
The impact of the proposed project will be the improved agricultural production and farm income in Pakpattan Canal command area (Okara, Pakpattan, Vehari and Lodhran districts). The outcome will be the improved and reliable water supplies for irrigated agriculture in Pakpattan Canal command area. The project outputs will be (i) rehabilitation of Pakpattan Canal and Suleimanki Barrage completed on time and within the budget; and (ii) EA's improved project management capacity. The project outputs will be achieved through recruitment of supervision consultants, rehabilitation of main weir and canals head regulators, installation of barrage gates and rehabilitation of Pakpattan Canal, Khadir Branch canal and Pakpattan-Islam link canal and appurtenant structures.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Designed water supplies up to 156 m3s-1 diverted to the canal and distribution system for at least 90% of the year by 2017 with no risk of failure compared to high risk of failure now.

title.narrative: Loan 2971: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: Overall project progress is 94% (Overall construction progress is 92%). The progress towards outcome will be assessed during the PCR Mission scheduled for Q2 2018.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/37231/37231-043-apfs-en.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Oct 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/37231/37231-043-smr-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jul 2014: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//37231-043-rp-01.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The physical progress on Pakpattan Canal Improvement subproject is 87%, while Sulemanki Barrage Improvement is substantially completed. Some works of the Pakpattan Canal could not be completed within the loan closing date that will be completed by Government of Punjab from own resources by 30 June 2018.
More than 14 PMO Staff were sent for training on procurement, financial management, and safeguards.
